Subject: Supplier enrollment request — next steps & PO assertion fields

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. AP team here—want to get Redwood Inference set up as a supplier in ZephrPay so our purchasing systems can issue POs and route invoices. To avoid delays we'll need: 

- Supplier enrollment packet (legal name, remit-to, tax id / VAT or self-cert, bank remit instructions)
- PO assertion mapping (which Redwood field populates our "Bill To" / "Ship To" / "PO Reference" lines)
- Confirmation whether Redwood accepts combined invoices and whether you support invoice-level VAT breakdowns (we operate in multiple EU countries)

Attached is our vendor intake form for reference. Can you return the enrollment packet and the small CSV mapping by EOD Monday (Mar 16)? Also let us know if you need an EU EORI or VAT registration record to be listed.

Thanks,
Olivia Martin
Head of Procurement Ops
ZephrPay

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the intake form.

Quick update and ask: we can provide the full AP onboarding packet and a PO assertion CSV that maps our internal invoice fields to ZephrPay's PO lines. I attached three files: Redwood_AP_Onboarding_Packet_ZephrPay.pdf, PO_Assertion_Mapping.csv (sample mappings + where to find the values in our invoices), and a copy of our EU self-cert (Redwood_W9_or_EU_SelfCert.pdf) — please accept the self-cert as our VAT evidence for now.

A couple of clarifications from our side that will help avoid stuck invoices:
- Do you require the supplier to be created with a specific remit-to ID? (we can provide one, but typically your system autogenerates it)
- For POs: do you need us to populate a specific field with the ZephrPay PO number (we can put it in the invoice 'Reference' line and in the XML 'OrderReference' element)?
- For EU VAT: if you need EORI we can provide the registration number; currently Redwood uses a central EU VAT registration in Ireland. Confirm preferred field for VAT id in the onboarding form.

If you want, Laura (cc'd) can coordinate banking docs, and Priyom can confirm the exact invoice element names for the XML/EDI payload. We aim to return everything you requested by EOD today.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment request — next steps & PO assertion fields

Thanks Mateo — received the packet. A couple of follow-ups from our AP ingestion team: 

1) PO assertion mapping: please confirm that the CSV's "Invoice.Reference" column will always contain the ZephrPay PO number. If your clients sometimes put PO into a different free-text field we need an invariant (we prefer OrderReference).

2) VAT evidence: we can accept the self-cert for enrollment but for invoice processing we need either (a) a VAT registration number per invoice or (b) an invoice-level VAT breakdown (lines with VAT amounts). Will Redwood be sending VAT per line?

3) Bank remittance: can you confirm whether Redwood sends an ACH/IBAN field in the outgoing invoice XML? If so please indicate the XML path (e.g. /Invoice/PaymentMeans/IBAN).

One more practical ask: our vendor portal requires a contact email for invoice exceptions that is monitored during CET business hours — will finance@redwood.com route properly? If not, please provide a monitored AP contact.

If you can confirm items 1–3 and provide the field paths we can complete enrollment and issue a test PO within 48 hours.

Best,
Michael Chen
AP Integration Lead
ZephrPay

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: AP Operations <ap@zephrpay.com>, michael.chen@zephrpay.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Supplier enrollment request — next steps & PO assertion fields

Hi Michael / Olivia — thanks for the quick review. Answers below inline for clarity.

1) PO field invariant: confirmed — our outbound invoices set the PO into OrderReference (XML) and into the invoice 'Reference' field. The CSV mapping notes both; we will ensure OrderReference is populated for ZephrPay POs. If your integration prefers we can also populate a dedicated invoice header field called 'BuyerOrderNumber' (let us know).

2) VAT handling: Redwood issues invoice-level VAT breakdowns by default for EU customers. Our invoices include per-line VAT and a VAT summary section with the VAT registration number. For enrollment accept the self-cert we attached; for operational invoices you will see VAT by line and the VAT registration number (we use Ireland VAT: IE12345678).

3) Bank remittance field: we include IBAN in /Invoice/PaymentMeans/IBAN on XML exports and include clear Remit-To instructions in the PDF invoice. We will add a short note in the onboarding packet pointing the portal mapping to that XML path.

4) AP contact: please route invoice exceptions to finance@redwood.com (monitored 9–17 CET). If you prefer a dedicated monitored alias we can create ap_invoices@redwood.com — let us know and we'll provision it.

Next steps:
- We'll update the attached PO_Assertion_Mapping.csv to include OrderReference + BuyerOrderNumber (if you choose) and re-upload the packet to the HubSpot deal.
- Once you confirm the remit-to ID behavior we'll finalize bank docs and you can issue a test PO.

Laura / Priyom — can you: (a) update the CSV with the extra BuyerOrderNumber column, (b) confirm the IBAN path is included in the packet, and (c) confirm whether we want ap_invoices@redwood.com created?

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
